title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Ampitheatre on 1982-07-28
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Sennheiser 421 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell UDXLII-C90/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear front‑of‑house sound captures a smoking Red Rocks show with a monster Let It Grow and adventurous second set.
ai_review.review: The recording is an airy, soft‑but‑clear FOH mix that reviewers rave about as “A+” and “incredible.”  Musically the concert is high‑energy, especially the second set – Let It Grow, Spanish Jam, Drums and Black Peter are highlighted as standout moments.  Overall the show feels adventurous and tightly executed, making it a top‑tier 1982 performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently five‑star comments praise both the musical firepower and the pristine FOH recording; only one outlier troll rating does not affect the overall assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, airy and soft mix; new transfers praised as "incredible"; no reported drop‑outs or major flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual song placements keep the set fresh; second set is particularly adventurous and tight, with a monster Let It Grow despite a minor vocal hiccup.

band_member_comments.Bob: Vocal hiccup noted on Let It Grow but overall performance praised.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum segment highlighted as a show highlight.
